scope: Shared map search for public Fresno named waterways/streets, all returned closure/detour records, loaded gauges/reservoirs and authorized loaded county sites. No permissions or AGOL items changed.

observed: Fresno Canal search selects and highlights actual generalized canal geometry in 3D with white/magenta selection style.
Shaw Avenue matches county streets and distinct closure/detour records; E SHAW AVE locates its line geometry.
Keyboard Enter locates the fictional EXERCISE pump station by ID P1.
Closing the pane preserves a completed highlight; Clear highlight removes it.
Tab change clears search geometry and the selected asset label.
Phone page has no horizontal overflow; results remain selectable alongside the map.
privacyTests: Unloaded / signed-out assets clear results, details, hidden selection label and highlight.
Clearing a pending geometry lookup prevents late navigation.
Private asset name search performs no external lookup.

limits: Named references only; unnamed waterways and arbitrary imagery/basemap labels are not indexed.
Same-name groups can contain disconnected segments and fit a broad extent. This is not routing, live flow, safe access or current road status.
Public search geometry uses five-meter display simplification and EPSG:4326 XY; no elevation or datum accuracy is inferred.
Private assets are available only after their authorized layers have been loaded; the interface does not grant access.
